title: Spider-Man: Friend or Foe
shortDescription: Spider-Man: Friend or Foe appears in GameAtlas's Nintendo DS family action and adventure and fighting and platformer collection, with a deterministic catalog-method note and a linked Wikidata structured-data record.
highlights: Places a source-linked action and adventure and fighting and platformer entry in the Nintendo DS family browsing path.
